Hi WISP.PL team,

MBUM hosts carry weight in this trade - and your catalogue already proves category openness: Scodeno industrial switches sit beside MikroTik and Ubiquiti. We would ask for exactly such a comparison row: a documented 24-port Gigabit PoE switch (280W, watchdog) at $165 USD EXW (2026-09-29) - the value answer beside your flagships, commercial and industrial (8-port DIN-rail).

We build a 24-port Gigabit PoE access switch (280W total budget, 802.3af/at, per-port watchdog, desktop or rack) with full English documentation. Reference: $165 USD EXW (2026-09-29) - a documented value tier beside the lines you already carry, not a replacement.

One question: would your switch category carry a documented value comparison row - either commercial or industrial?

Best regards,
Saga Telecom - PoE switch OEM/ODM
